intro.text: A hot, overgrown valley in the mountains near Urithiru, between Emul and Hexi, where people come seeking a boon from the Nightwatcher.

description.text: Around the Valley the land is bare and few people live. The ground is creased into wrinkles a few inches deep, lichen on the stormward side and flattened grass on the leeward, with hunched, thistle-leaved trees and small black birds.

Foothills shelter the Valley from highstorms, so plant life grows so densely it seems impassable apart from a few trails. The air is muggy and damp, vines and moss hang everywhere, the ground is rotten wood, and it is dark enough inside to barely see.

items.text: Even Alethi nobles journey to the Valley to ask the Nightwatcher for a boon. When Dalinar went there, he could not feel the Thrill, and he saw a vision of himself killing Elhokar, taking the throne and conquering the world.
